create_runconfig: create a RunConfig instance with replay_dir, data_dir, tmp_dir, and version for running StarCraft II
run_map_data: run map_data to retrieve binary map data by map name from the data directory
save_replay: save replay data to a directory with an optional prefix and return the saved replay path
get_versions: get all available StarCraft II game versions from the VERSIONS dictionary
iterate_subclasses: iterate all subclasses of RunConfig using the all_subclasses class method
